productionRecipe.action: Start the same official private soffice.bin headless with a fresh private UserInstallation and unique named UNO pipe. Give both server and bundled Python client the same private bootstrap profile. Use an accessible distro-local private HOME for UNO executable backing files and a private temp/cache directory.

Create a hidden private:factory/swriter document with MacroExecutionMode short0 and UpdateDocMode short0. Create real body paragraphs through insertString/insertControlCharacter(PARAGRAPH_BREAK=0); append the explicitly expected terminal empty body paragraph.

At the F1/E1/F2/E2 body keys insert official automatic Footnote/Endnote text objects. Populate exactly2 actual paragraphs per note through PARAGRAPH_BREAK, not LF linebreak insertion. Apply Times New Roman10pt, then bold150/NONE to bold and normal100/ITALIC to italic.
Set Arabic numbering NumberingType4 and StartAt0 on both kinds, continuous FootnoteCounting2 and PositionEndOfDocfalse for footnotes; retain empty automatic labels and prefixes/suffixes.

Assert actual fresh object collections/text/paragraphs/selectedformat spans/body anchor order/settings before export. This run passed54checks, including exactly8note paragraphs and6nonemptybody paragraphs plus terminalempty.

Export through XStorable.storeToURL to a new absent output path with FilterName MS WinWord 6.0 and Overwritefalse. Hash output immediately. The original saved Word DOCX is a hash-bound independent semantic oracle and is not modified or imported by this authoring route.

Close fresh owned document, reopen generated legacy file Hidden/ReadOnly with MacroExecutionMode short0 and UpdateDocMode short0, record exact note/paragraph/portion/anchor/settings values before shutdown. Inspect actual CFB WordDocument FIB/PLCs separately; do not infer profile from extension or filter name.

Serialize primitive operation receipts before termination; close owned document once, release proxies/gc, call desktop.terminate as final remote operation. Independently retain actual client/server exit and surviving owned PIDs. Do not equate terminate returntrue with clean native exit.
